Product Features

  • Tall and narrow design, 35 x 50 x 165 cm, a luxurious display cabinet exclusively for the living room.
  • The interior is divided into four levels that combine storage and display functions.
  • The entire cabinet is covered with a high-gloss black lacquer, which gives it a particularly noble, mirror-like surface.
  • The transparent viewing area is made of high-strength tempered glass.
  • Asymmetrical, curved surfaces soften the sharp edges of the square cabinet.
  • An integrated LED light strip illuminates the interior with a touch of understated luxury.
  • Minimalist Italian style in dark light, suitable for a variety of modern interior styles
  • Place it on the wall in different scenarios to easily increase the ceiling height of the entire house.
  • Made of eco-friendly chipboard, the cabinet is sturdy and can support a weight of up to 40 kg.
  • Note: This product is shipped in 2 packages and can be delivered in multiple partial deliveries. Please make sure you have received all the packages before you start building!

Descriptions

Descriptions

This living room cabinet measures 35 x 50 x 165 cm and has four shelves. It impresses with its high-gloss cabinet doors and serves as living room furniture and storage furniture with integrated LED lighting. The transparent parts of the doors are made of tempered glass. The upper and lower edges of the open exhibition area in the middle of the doors are asymmetrical, flowing, concave and undulating, breaking away from the austerity of conventional, square cabinets. The style is minimalist, elegant and subtly luxurious. The glossy black finish, ornate curves and blue ambient lighting make it the ideal complement for modern, minimalist, Italian minimalist, dark and contemporary minimalist home styles. Whether placed on the bedroom wall, in the entrance area or in a corner of the living room - it becomes a stylish decorative object. Its slim, tall design saves space and makes the room look larger. Recommended load capacity: 40 kg. Material: Black chipboard.

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.

Attention to detail

The asymmetrical curved surface softens the sharp angles of the square case, and the transparent viewing area is made of high-strength tempered glass.

Large storage space

The interior is divided into four levels that combine storage and display functions.

High-gloss material

The entire case is made of high-gloss black material with an outstanding mirror-like finish.
